in_marathi.name: Dronraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the chariot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dronraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dronraj is the name of the legendary sage and charioteer of Arjuna in Hindu mythology. He is considered a guru, a guide, and a master of weapons. He imparted knowledge to Arjuna through the Bhagavad Gita, and his teachings are an essential part of Hindu spirituality.
